description: This file implements constant folding optimizations for ONNX models within the PyTorch JIT compiler, including functions for handling ONNX data types, slice operations, and graph transformations.

classes.name: OnnxType
classes.description: Enumeration of ONNX data types used for type conversions.

methods.name: handleNegativeStartEndIndex
methods.description: Adjusts negative start and end indices for slicing operations based on tensor size.

methods.name: runTorchSlice_opset9
methods.description: Performs constant folding for ONNX Slice operation (opset 9).

methods.name: runTorchSlice_opset10
methods.description: Performs constant folding for ONNX Slice operation (opset 10 and above).

methods.name: runTorchArange_opset11
methods.description: Generates a range tensor for ONNX Range operation (opset 11).

methods.name: IntToTensor
methods.description: Converts an integer value to a 1D tensor.

methods.name: runTorchBackendForOnnx
methods.description: Executes specific tensor operations based on ONNX node kind for constant folding.

methods.name: isConstant
methods.description: Checks if a value is a constant or parameter.

methods.name: hasParamInput
methods.description: Checks if a node has parameter inputs.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves tensor values from nodes for constant folding.

methods.name: areNodeInputsConstant
methods.description: Checks if all inputs to a node are constant.

methods.name: getOnnxConstParentsToRemove
methods.description: Identifies ONNX constant parent nodes to remove during graph optimization.

methods.name: ConstantFoldONNX
methods.description: Performs in-place constant folding on a graph block for ONNX nodes.
